name: HackMD
title: hackmd.io
shortDescription: HackMD is a collaborative Markdown editor designed to accelerate innovation, foster community, and enhance collaboration. It is ideal for teams and individuals who need a flexible, web-based platform for sharing knowledge and documentation. Users can create, manage, and share Markdown documents, integrate with GitHub, and utilize features like UML graphs and book mode for organizing content.
cons: Can be overwhelming for Markdown beginners
Potential privacy concerns with cloud-based storage

aiSuggestedAlternatives.name: Notion
aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Flexible workspace with rich content support
